label: 슈퍼트렌드 하락 전환
formula: Wilder ATR10 ×3; recursive bands; bullish-to-bearish close-confirmed flip

label: 파라볼릭 SAR 하락 반전
formula: PSAR .02/.02/.20; bullish-to-bearish reversal, known at current close

label: StochRSI K80 이탈
formula: Wilder RSI14, range14, SMA3 K; K crosses below80; zero range unknown

label: StochRSI 고위 K/D 교차
formula: K crosses below SMA3(K), previous K>=80

label: RMI70 이탈
formula: Wilder20 of positive/negative 5-day close differences; crosses below70

label: RMI50 이탈
formula: Wilder20 of positive/negative 5-day close differences; crosses below50

label: 체이킨 0선 이탈
formula: EMA3(ADL)-EMA10(ADL) crosses below0; H=L contributes0 to ADL

label: 분기 고정 VWAP 대용치 이탈
formula: C crosses below cumulative TP*V/sum(V), calendar quarter/segment anchor, at least5 previous anchor bars

label: 거래량 오실레이터·하락일
formula: SMA5(V)/SMA20(V)-1 crosses above0 AND C<previous C

label: 확정 프랙탈 저점 이탈
formula: Strict5-bar low pivot confirmed at pivot+2; close crosses below latest confirmed pivot low; never backdated

label: MACD 데드·최근3일 RSI60 이탈
formula: macd_signal AND 당일 포함 최근3거래일 중 rsi60 발생(오늘,t-1,t-2)

label: 스토캐스틱(14,3,3) K 80 이탈
formula: rawK=100*(C-최저L14)/(최고H14-최저L14), K=SMA3(rawK), K가80을 신규 하향 교차
